topic: historically, the algorithms here are notoriously bad at handling near-symmetric objects/objects with strong rotational symmetry. (shoulder implants/hip implants) - they do not provide robust enough signal when it comes to the symmetric axis for the current cost functions to work well. Some work was attempted with the curvature heatmaps to overcome this, but that was still not great. Let's find some different angles here using subagents and the zotero plugin tha tmight be a better way to approach these near-symmetric implants like hips and shoulders
